name: Yamabuki Noa
source: Noa is Sakura's best friend, and is nearly always by her side when not at home. Noa is especially attentive around Sakura, taking appropriate rest breaks and fending off guys who try to flirt with her. Has a slight tendency to blurt out phrases or words in English.
